description: Markings by column name, for columns no other override types. A raw column of one of value_types whose name matches and does not match unless keeps its type (measure and currency undeclared, so plx.aggregate and plx.compare refuse to combine a decimal or text one) and carries the marking, so a reader without it never sees it. exceptions: such names that are not what the rule reads them as, with the evidence. Rules apply in order; declared money columns are skipped.

name_rules.applied: the name reads as money; no measure or currency is declared

exceptions.reason: the quantity of the component used, not money (docs/reference/portal-code-map.md section 3.8: ManufacturingOrderLine quantity = required, actual_amount = used)
the FM component consumption (qty_per_batch x produced units), not money (operating/source_unit_contracts.json silver-assembly-order-items-actual-amount-actual)
